preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each character in the strings must be an alphabetic character.

postconditions.description: The length of the output list must be equal to the length of the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) for count in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= len(word) for count, word in zip(return_value, words))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list must be between 0 and the length of the corresponding word.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum((ord(c.lower()) - ord('a') + 1) == (i + 1) for i, c in enumerate(word)) for count, word in zip(return_value, words))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list represents the number of letters in the corresponding word that occupy their positions in the alphabet.
